managed_frames.reserve_justification: 800-byte Go NOSPLIT reserve minus 160 bytes: 40-byte invocation gateway plus at most 120-byte automatic LoongArch NOSPLIT leaf. morestack allocates no user-stack frame before switching to g0. Outgoing homes are included in the generated frame. Indirect calls retain Go linker assumptions about splittable callees; aggregate arbitrary NOSPLIT/generated call chains are not proven by a per-frame cap.
managed_frames.leaf_saves: drop unconditional full C save sets for managed leaf entries; keep actual allocated GPR saves. Allocation/expansion FPRs are C-volatile. Functions with Go calls keep all C-preserved GPR/FPR saves.
